model.note: Part outlines are traced from John Deere's product photo of a 3520 with ROPS, a 300CX loader and a backhoe, and are approximate. The loader and backhoe are not in the machinery bible, so they have no pieces; check whether Tractor 1 or 2 carries them. The filters, transmission, front axle, cooling, battery and hitch are hidden and are in the parts list. Part numbers come from OM omlvu19809 (North American edition, S/N 310000-699999) and the JD shop. Tractor 2's recorded serial LVA13144 is a JD part number: read its PIN plate, and record eHydro or PowrReverser for both tractors.

rops.name: ROPS and seat belt
rops.desc: Test the safety systems every 10 h or daily (OEM). The amber and red hazard and turn lamps on the ROPS report open or short circuits on the dash as Err 60-67. Cab tractors only: check the cab ROPS mounting hardware torque after the first 10 h and every 50 h.

lampR.name: RH amber hazard lamp (ROPS)
lampR.desc: On the machine's right (far side in this photo). Dash codes Err 64/65 = right amber lamp (ON = short, OFF = open). Err 65 is "Right Amber Lamp OFF": the output from the display is open and there is no right hazard signal on the ROPS. Tractor 2 has an open Err 65: a blown bulb or open wiring or connector to this lamp, not a brake light fault. Other ROPS lamp codes: Err 60/61 right red, 62/63 left red, 66/67 left amber.

lampL.name: LH amber hazard lamp (ROPS)
lampL.desc: On the machine's left (near side in this photo). Dash codes Err 66/67 = left amber lamp (ON = short, OFF = open). Other ROPS lamp codes: Err 60/61 right red, 62/63 left red, 64/65 right amber.

seat.name: Operator seat
seat.desc: The seat switch is part of the safety system: test it every 10 h or daily. Err 15 on the dash = operator not in seat. The transmission oil dipstick is behind the seat: check the level every 10 h or daily, between the marks, and allow 1 h for the oil to settle for an accurate reading.

steering.name: Steering wheel
steering.desc: Every 50 h grease the steering cylinder ball joints and tie-rod ends. Check and adjust front toe-in as needed.

hood.name: Hood, grille and side screens
hood.desc: Every 10 h or daily: engine oil level, radiator coolant level and the air filter dust unloading valve. Service the air filter only when the air restriction light on the dash shows. As needed: clean the grille, side screens, radiator screen and engine bay.

lights.name: Headlights
lights.desc: Headlights in the hood. Bulbs, fuses and the battery are as-needed items (OEM). 12 V, 500 CCA battery.

fender.name: Rear fender, left
fender.desc: Check for loose or damaged parts every 10 h or daily (OEM daily checks).

platform.name: Operator platform and step
platform.desc: The brake and travel pedals are on the platform: check the brake adjustment every 600 h. Err 02/03 on the dash = pedal signal fault.

tyreFL.name: Front tyre, left (MFWD)
tyreFL.desc: Read the sidewall and use the OM pressure table for the fitted tyre (e.g. 25/10.50LL-15 golf tyre at 10 psi). Check wheel bolt torque after the first 10 h and every 200 h. Check pressures daily.

tyreFR.name: Front tyre, right (MFWD)
tyreFR.desc: Read the sidewall and use the OM pressure table for the fitted tyre (e.g. 25/10.50LL-15 golf tyre at 10 psi). Check wheel bolt torque after the first 10 h and every 200 h. Check pressures daily.

tyreRL.name: Rear tyre, left
tyreRL.desc: Read the sidewall and use the OM pressure table for the fitted tyre (e.g. 41LLx18-16.1 golf tyre at 6 psi). The photo shows agricultural tyres. Check wheel bolt torque after the first 10 h and every 200 h. Check pressures daily.

engine.name: Engine: Yanmar 3TNV84T-BMJT turbo diesel (left side visible under the hood)
engine.desc: 3-cylinder, 1.5 L turbo diesel, 27.7 kW gross; rated 2600 rpm, low idle 950 rpm, high idle 2775 rpm; air-heater start aid (no glow plugs). Not a 3TNV82A. Oil 4.8 L with filter: JD Plus-50 or Torq-Gard Supreme (or ACEA E4/E5, API CI-4/CH-4 or ACEA E3; no break-in oils). Change oil and filter M806419 every 200 h or yearly, warm, filter hand-tight plus 1/2 turn. At 200 h also inspect the alternator belt and test the air restriction light (block the intake hose with cardboard at full rpm: the light must come on). 600 h: check low idle (950 +/- 25 rpm) and the air intake hoses and clamps. 1200 h: valve clearance (dealer). 2 years or 2000 h: injection nozzles (dealer). Hours Oct 2026: Tractor 1 about 3,070 h, Tractor 2 about 2,970 h; next 200/400 h service at 3,200 h for both.

oilfilter.name: Engine oil filter
oilfilter.desc: Change with the oil every 200 h or yearly (4.8 L).

aircleaner.name: Air cleaner
aircleaner.desc: Replace the primary element RE68048 only when the air restriction light shows. The secondary RE68049 is not a routine item: inspect it in place; if you replace it, fit a new primary at the same time. Check the rubber dust unloading valve every 10 h or daily.

fuel.name: Fuel tank and filter
fuel.desc: Diesel tank 51.1 L (44 L with cab). Replace the fuel filter MIU800645 (supersedes M811031) in the sediment bowl every 400 h and yearly: close the fuel tap and clean the bowl, ring and spring; the system is self-bleeding. Yearly drain water from the fuel tank. As needed service the water separator and clean the fuel tank overfill reservoir.

transmission.name: Transmission and hydraulic oil, suction filter
transmission.desc: Every 400 h change the oil and the hydraulic suction filter element LVA13065: eHydro 25.7 L, PowrReverser 23.8 L. Which transmission each tractor has is not recorded. JD Low Viscosity Hy-Gard (J20D) recommended; Hy-Gard J20C is fine above -18 C. Never use engine oil or type F ATF. Every 1200 h, with an oil change, remove, clean (mild solvent) and refit the in-line hydraulic filter with the flow arrow toward the transmission fitting. Err 57 = HST controller timeout; Err 02/03 = pedal signal.

frontaxle.name: Front axle (MFWD)
frontaxle.desc: Check the oil every 50 h (dipstick on the right side of the axle). Change every 600 h: drain the differential and both axle plugs, fill to the dipstick, 4.5 L JD Low Viscosity Hy-Gard J20D (the procedure page says about 5.0 L). At 600 h loosen the thrust bolt jam nut, torque the bolt to 32 N.m and re-lock.

cooling.name: Radiator and coolant
cooling.desc: 5.3 L JD Cool-Gard (7.0 L with cab). Check the level every 10 h or daily. Flush and refill every 2 years or 2000 h. Replace radiator hoses and clamps as needed. Check all hoses and clamps yearly.

belt.name: Alternator belt
belt.desc: LVU11661 with the 40 A alternator, LVU11662 with the 55 A or 75 A alternator: check which is fitted. Inspect every 200 h; replace when worn.

battery.name: Battery
battery.desc: 12 V, 500 CCA. OM part TY25877 is not on the current JD shop: buy a 12 V battery of at least 500 CCA. Check the electrolyte level yearly.

display.name: Dash display and error codes
display.desc: Err 08 = throttle sensor voltage out of range or not calibrated (no anti-stall, loss of performance): dealer calibration or wiring check. Err 02/03 = pedal signal. Err 15 = operator not in seat. Err 57 = HST controller timeout. Err 60-67 = ROPS lamps (60/61 right red, 62/63 left red, 64/65 right amber, 66/67 left amber; ON = short, OFF = open).

hitch.name: 3-point hitch, drawbar and PTO (behind the backhoe in this photo)
hitch.desc: Every 50 h grease the 3-point hitch lift links and use Super Lube on the ball joints and drawbar. Keep the PTO guard fitted (daily check). Machine grease: JD Multi-Purpose SD Polyurea or HD Lithium Complex (NLGI 2); grease daily in very wet or muddy work.

brakes.name: Brakes
brakes.desc: Check the brake adjustment every 600 h.

cab.name: Cab air filter (cab tractors only)
cab.desc: MIU10010: clean or replace every 50 h on cab tractors. Not needed on a ROPS tractor; Tractor 2 has ROPS lamps, so check whether either tractor has a cab before ordering.

LVU11662.name: Alternator belt, 55 A or 75 A alternator
LVU11662.note: Only if the larger alternator is fitted; LVU11661 for the 40 A alternator.
